Editor.SignalSend.AccessibleName: Send Signal (preview only, root scope, works while paused)
Editor.SignalSend.Help: Preview only: send once at the current playhead in root scope, including ordinary Graph Groups. Works while paused without advancing time or changing the project. Requires a connected compiled-preview (v3) client.
Editor.SignalSend.InstanceTargetRequired: Send is unavailable in Spawnable scope. Explicit instance targeting is not implemented; child Signals are never broadcast implicitly.
Editor.SignalSend.CompiledClientRequired: Signal not sent. Connect a compiled-preview (protocol v3) client, then try Send again.
Editor.SignalSend.Requested: Preview Signal requested at the current playhead (root scope). This is not a runtime delivery acknowledgment.
Editor.NodeHelp.Sequence: On each received Signal, execute outputs from top to bottom. Each output has one destination. Delay continuations and spawned instances are not awaited.
Editor.Sequence.RemoveOutput: Remove last Signal output and its connection
Editor.Sequence.SingleDestination: A Signal output can have only one destination. Add a Sequence node to branch.
Editor.NodeHelp.LifeTime: Place directly inside a Spawnable Group. Seconds are captured once when that instance starts. Without this node, the instance is infinite; the effect root has no Life Time.
Editor.NodeHelp.OwnerDestroy: Place directly inside a Spawnable Group. The owner sends this once when it naturally ends or is explicitly ended; it does not force the instance to stop.
Editor.NodeHelp.OnDestroy: Place at the effect root. Fires once after the root ends naturally and all Spawnable instances and scheduled work have drained. Manual stop does not fire it.
Editor.NodeHelp.Delay: Delays a signal in its effect or Spawnable's local time. Pending signals and their subsequent work keep the owner alive. Manual Stop cancels them.
Editor.NodeHelp.SpawnInput: Adds an input pin to this Spawnable. Capture at spawn freezes its initial value; Live reads the parent's value before each update and OnStart. Life Time is still captured only once.
Editor.NodeHelp.SpawnInputSignal: Adds a local signal input to this Spawnable. Each signal is broadcast to every currently active child instance. Spawn still creates a new instance, and Destroy remains a per-instance lifecycle event.
Editor.NodeHelp.SpawnOutputSignal: Emits a local signal event for the instance that reaches this node. The host routes one event per emitting instance; this is separate from the natural Destroy output.
Editor.NodeHelp.SpawnableGroup: Double-click to edit the spawned instance. Then fires immediately on Spawn; Destroy fires only on natural expiry, not manual stop.
Editor.Lifecycle.OwnerHelp: This configured Life Time is not a guaranteed destruction time. Pending continuations and active child instances can keep the owner alive after it elapses. With no Life Time node, the owner is unbounded.
Editor.Lifecycle.InstanceLifeHelp: Life Time is captured once when this instance starts. It is not a guaranteed final destruction time: active children or pending continuations can keep the owner alive.
Editor.Lifecycle.DelayHelp: Delay schedules a signal in local time; it does not contain child nodes. Pending continuations can keep the owner alive. This value is an input-dependent duration, not a final destruction time.
Editor.AutoDestroyWhenIdleHelp: When enabled, the root begins natural shutdown after its startup signals and root-local queued work drain, notifies live Spawnable instances, then waits for them and their work before On Destroy. Disable to keep an idle launcher alive for future game signals. Effects without Spawnable Groups remain infinite.

Editor.LanguageHint: The interface language changes immediately. User content and node identifiers are not translated.
Editor.LanguageSettingsInvalid: Language settings could not be read. The original file has been preserved; repair or remove language.json and restart the editor before changing the language.
Editor.LanguageSaveFailed: Could not save the language preference. The previous language is still active.
Panels.ContainingSpawnableHint: No child node selected. Edit this Spawnable instance's published values here; the child template defaults are unchanged.
Editor.NodeNotInProject: This node type is not available in the active project.
Editor.DragHint: Drag a node to the graph to add it.
Editor.SelectNodeHint: Select a node in the graph to edit its properties.
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.SaveGroup: Save group to the active project library
Editor.GroupUnlinked: Not yet saved to the project library. Saving creates a reusable asset.
Editor.GroupLocked: Locked. Instances cannot be edited or saved over this asset.
Editor.GroupUnlocked: Unlocked. Instance edits are saved to the library only with Save group.
Editor.GroupMissing: This asset is not in the active project library. The embedded graph is preserved.
Editor.GroupNoLibrary: Choose a group library directory in Settings / Projects before saving.
Editor.PluginsDisabled: Custom DLL inspectors are disabled. Set LIBERAFX_INSPECTOR_PLUGINS=1 to load trusted editors.
Editor.InspectorTrustHelp: Inspector DLLs run as trusted code with the same permissions as LIBERA FX. They are not sandboxed. A DLL is only executed after you explicitly trust and enable it; enabling or disabling requires a restart.
Editor.InspectorInstallHint: Choose a plugin output folder containing liberafx-inspector.json, the declared DLL, and its dependencies. The folder is copied into LIBERA FX user data.
Editor.InspectorSearch: Search plugins by name, ID, inspector or type
Editor.InspectorLocalFolderRequired: Choose a local folder to add an inspector plugin.
Editor.InspectorDefaultsHint: Automatic uses the built-in editor or the compatible legacy provider. A missing, disabled or incompatible selection falls back to the built-in editor without changing graph values.
Editor.InspectorStatusEnabledRestart: Enabled for next restart. DLL code runs with the editor user's permissions; no sandbox is provided.
Editor.InspectorStatusEnabledNew: Enabled for next restart; this new DLL has not been executed.
Editor.InspectorStatusUntrusted: Not trusted or enabled. DLL not executed.
Editor.InspectorStatusTrustRequired: Enabled preference ignored because this DLL has not been explicitly trusted.
Editor.InspectorStatusLoaded: Trusted and loaded. DLL code runs with the editor user's permissions; no sandbox is provided.
Editor.InspectorTrustWarning: This plugin can execute arbitrary code as your user, access files, and communicate with the network. It is not sandboxed. Only continue if you obtained and reviewed this plugin from a source you trust. It loads after restarting LIBERA FX.
Editor.InspectorTrustConfirm: I trust this plugin and enable it
Editor.InspectorRestartHint: Plugin enablement changes take effect after restarting LIBERA FX. Per-type inspector choices are saved separately from graph values and undo history.
Editor.StartupSetupAppearanceHint: You can change your color scheme at any time in Settings → Appearance.
Editor.StartupSetupCrashHint: Crash drafts stay on this device. Nothing is sent unless you review the report and explicitly choose to send it.
Editor.StartupSetupSaveFailed: Could not save first-run setup. You can close this window to continue without saving setup completion.
Editor.ShortcutHint: Click a shortcut, then press a key combination. Escape cancels.
Editor.ShortcutTooltip: Click here and press a key combination
Editor.ServerHint: MCP listens on loopback only. Preview accepts authenticated TLS connections.
Editor.ProjectHint: Core nodes are always available. Each project adds JSON node definitions and reusable groups from its own directories. Switching projects only changes the node list; open documents and their history are preserved.
Editor.GroupUpdatesSummary: {0} linked group(s) have newer versions. Update all unchanged groups, or keep the versions currently embedded in your documents.
Editor.GroupUpdateUndo: Updates can be undone in each document.
Editor.GroupUpdateConflicts: {0} group(s) have local changes, a nested conflict, or a missing original revision and will not be overwritten. Updates can be undone in each document.
Editor.McpRunningDebug: Running (loopback only; token required; graph UI debug enabled)
Editor.ShutdownFailed: Shutdown failed: {0}. Close the window to retry.
Editor.CutCancelled: The graph changed while copying; cut was cancelled.
Editor.ClipboardNotNodes: The clipboard does not contain LIBERA FX nodes.
Matrix.NodeHelp.Source: Reads one bone from the current animated pose. Target is the effect owner or an explicitly registered key; no scene-wide search is performed. Bone Local is relative to the parent bone, Component is relative to the target component, and World is the engine world transform. Check Valid before using Matrix.
Matrix.Parameter.Rotation: Rotation (degrees: X roll, Y pitch, Z yaw)
Editor.SignalExecutionOrderHelp: Each connection runs in order, including its downstream branches. Disconnect and reconnect a branch to move it to the end.
Editor.Error.GroupChanged: The group asset changed; reload it first.
Editor.Error.GroupRevisionConflict: The saved group revision conflicts with the current asset.
Editor.HelpGroupsDescription: Choose a project library in Settings / Projects. Select a graph group and use the inspector's save icon to publish it. The padlock icon locks or unlocks asset editing. Add saved groups from the node list; double-click a group to open it. Library updates are confirmed together and preserve locally edited instances.
Editor.HelpLanguageDescription: Choose English or Japanese in Settings / Appearance / Language. Labels and tooltips update immediately. Project contents, node identifiers, and your names and comments are preserved.
